headline: FDA targets self-GRAS; Foreverland cocoa-free chocolate lands at Granarolo; NY allergen law live
summary: FDA has proposed mandatory notification of self-GRAS determinations and millers and bakers are seeking more time, so Puratos should inventory self-GRAS ingredients and join the trade response.

Italian dairy giant Granarolo is putting Foreverland's carob-based cocoa-free chocolate into Yomo kefir, another sign cocoa alternatives are going mainstream and a partner or competitor to watch for Belcolade.
New York's allergen labelling law for prepacked food is now in effect and a three-additive ban awaits the governor, so check labels and formulations for bread and sweets sold in the state.
A mannitol-producing Leuconostoc sourdough allowed 50% sugar reduction in muffins with soft crumb, a fermentation route to sugar reduction worth testing in cakes.
State dye bans in school meals keep spreading, supporting demand for natural-colour glazes, icings and fillings.

items.title: Italy's Granarolo Brings Foreverland's Cocoa-Free Chocolate to Yomo Kefir
items.summary: Italian dairy cooperative Granarolo is using Foreverland's carob-based cocoa-free chocolate in its Yomo kefir range.
items.why: Another major food brand adopting cocoa-free chocolate shows the category is moving mainstream; Belcolade should track Foreverland as a partner or competitor in cocoa alternatives.

items.title: Granarolo adds Foreverland’s cocoa-free chocolate to Yomo kefir
items.summary: Granarolo adds Foreverland's cocoa-free chocolate to its Yomo kefir products.
items.why: Mainstream uptake of carob-based cocoa-free chocolate by a large dairy brand; relevant to Belcolade's cocoa-alternative strategy.

items.title: Italian Dairy Giant Granarolo Embraces Foreverland’s Cocoa-Free Chocolate in Kefir Range
items.summary: Puglia-based start-up Foreverland has signed a partnership with Granarolo, Italy's leading dairy cooperative, to supply carob-based cocoa-free chocolate for Yomo kefir.
items.why: Foreverland is scaling through big-brand partnerships, making it a cocoa-alternative partner, licensing or competitive watch target for Belcolade amid high cocoa prices.

items.title: New York Lawmakers Voted to Ban 3 Food Additives Found in Bagels, Pizza Dough and Candy, and Now It’s Up to Hochul
items.summary: New York lawmakers passed a bill banning three food additives found in bagels, pizza dough and candy; it now awaits Governor Hochul's signature.
items.why: A New York additive ban would force reformulation of bread and confectionery sold in the state; Puratos should check which improvers and colours are affected and prepare compliant alternatives.

items.title: Millers, bakers seeking extension for GRAS rule
items.summary: US millers and bakers are asking FDA for more time to respond to its proposed rule on GRAS determinations.
items.why: Signals industry concern about the GRAS rule's impact on bakery ingredients; Puratos should join the trade-association response and review which of its ingredients rely on self-GRAS.

items.title: FDA Proposes Requiring Mandatory Notifications for Self-GRAS Determinations
items.summary: FDA has proposed requiring mandatory notification of self-affirmed GRAS determinations for food ingredients.
items.why: Ending silent self-GRAS would affect ingredient suppliers like Puratos and its customers across all units; inventory self-GRAS ingredients and prepare notifications or comments.

items.title: Multi-Analytical Evaluation of Reduced-Added-Sugar Muffins Obtained with Leuconostoc citreum DSM 5577 Fermented Sourdough: Focus on Texture, Microstructure, Color, Aroma Profile, and Sensory Characteristics
items.summary: Romanian researchers used a mannitol-producing Leuconostoc citreum sourdough to make 50% reduced-added-sugar muffins with soft crumb and high acceptance.
items.why: A fermentation route to sugar reduction in cakes and muffins that fits Puratos's sourdough and patisserie sugar-reduction work.
entities: University of Agricultural Sciences and Veterinary Medicine Cluj-Napoca

items.title: Buttenschon: New York’s Prepackaged Food Allergen Labeling Law in effect
items.summary: New York's Prepackaged Food Allergen Labeling Law has taken effect.
items.why: Bakery, patisserie and chocolate customers selling prepacked goods in New York must meet the new allergen labelling rules; Puratos should confirm its allergen declarations support them.

items.title: Is the future of food colour changing the flavour game?
items.summary: Bakery and snack producers face trade-offs between natural colours, flavour performance, cost and consumer expectations as synthetic dyes come under scrutiny.
items.why: Natural colour transitions affect glazes, icings, fillings and decorations; a chance for Puratos to offer dye-free colour solutions.

items.title: Effect of lactobacillus plantarum addition on the proximate composition, anti-nutritional factors, and amino acid profile of sourdough bread
items.summary: A L. plantarum starter isolated from acha sourdough cut phytic acid and oxalates in wheat sourdough bread while keeping protein and fibre stable.
items.why: Supports nutritional claims for sourdough fermentation; a possible strain idea for Sapore starter cultures.

items.title: Nowhere Bakery launches grain-free pizza dough mix
items.summary: Nowhere Bakery launched a grain-free pizza dough mix with 11 g protein and 10 g fibre.
items.why: Shows US demand for high-protein, high-fibre grain-free mixes, an opportunity for Tegral-style protein/fibre enriched mixes.

items.title: D-allulose applications in the food industry: sensory evaluation, food safety, and global regulatory approval status
items.summary: A Gachon University review covers D-allulose use in foods (cookies, buns, muffins, chocolate), its sensory effects, safety and global regulatory status.
items.why: Useful reference for allulose-based sugar reduction across patisserie, chocolate and sweet bakery, including its browning and anti-staling effects.

items.title: Hershey takes festive treats beyond chocolate
items.summary: Hershey unveiled a holiday range mixing themed chocolates and sweet-and-salty snack mixes.
items.why: Signals US confectionery seasonal trends (nostalgia, sweet-salty) relevant to Belcolade's customer innovation ideas.

items.title: Functionality, low sugar, and sourness emerge as trends in confectionery
items.summary: Functionality, low sugar and sourness are emerging confectionery trends.
items.why: Low-sugar and functional trends support Belcolade's reduced-sugar chocolate and fillings development.

items.title: Near-infrared hyperspectral imaging for monitoring sugar bloom development in dark chocolate under controlled humidity conditions
items.summary: Researchers used near-infrared hyperspectral imaging to monitor sugar bloom development in dark chocolate under controlled humidity.
items.why: A non-destructive way to detect bloom could support Belcolade quality control and shelf-life testing.

items.title: 13 States Have Now Passed Laws Banning Food Dyes in School Meals, and 5 of Them Are Already in Effect: The Full List
items.summary: Thirteen US states have passed laws banning certain food dyes in school meals, five already in effect.
items.why: Bakery and confectionery products for school foodservice need dye-free versions; supports demand for natural-colour glazes, icings and fillings.

items.title: KSU Center to advance grain-based foods: Ardent Mills
items.summary: Ardent Mills is backing a Kansas State University center to advance grain-based foods.
items.why: An industry-academia grain center in the US is a potential research partner for Puratos bakery and flour innovation.

items.title: MIWE unveils eco mode energy saving technology
items.summary: MIWE launched an eco mode oven technology to save energy while keeping in-store ovens ready to bake.
items.why: Energy-saving ovens matter to Puratos's in-store and retail bakery customers and to bake-off product guidance.

items.title: US revokes approval for 3 food-color solvents manufacturers say they've already stopped using
items.summary: The US revoked approval for three food-colour solvents that manufacturers say they no longer use.
items.why: Little immediate change, but colour suppliers' specifications should be checked as part of the wider US colour clean-up.
